name: OpenPanel
description: Open-source web and product analytics, an alternative to Mixpanel

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The PostgreSQL and ClickHouse databases with all your events, Redis, and this install's secret keys (state/secrets.env). Back up the whole folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: OpenPanel dashboard and tracking API (at /api), published on host as 6191

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6191, or use your https address. The dashboard and the tracking script on your websites talk to it. Keep the port at 6191.
